page0.text:
...
My heart hurts.
Blood runs down the fingers that are gripping the knife.

page1.text:
"...Nngh!"
I grind my teeth.
I desperately try to stifle the sobs rising to my throat.

page2.text:
"Kh...haah..."
My eyelids feel hot.
I can't bear to look down, so I raise my head and control my anger.

page3.text:
...I lower the knife.
No matter how hard I try, I can't manage something so simple.
It pisses me off.
Seriously, something's wrong with me.
After everything I've done to come this far, I finally know my own heart.

page4.text:
"...I'm a fool."
...Yes.
I came to an answer long ago.
It was a choice I made with fatal conviction as I held Sakura that night in the rain.

page6.text:
Something tells me to remember.
Didn't you say that you would be a hero? That you'd do what's right?
The competing thoughts are tearing my body apart.

page7.text:
A "hero" who will kill many people tonight for Sakura's sake.
A "hero" who's always been selfish.

page8.text:
Kiritsugu, who cast off his own feelings for what he believed in.
A powerless human who saves others only for his own satisfaction.

page9.text:
The fire ten years ago.
In exchange for being the only survivor, I've lived my life trying to prevent such a tragedy from ever happening again.

page10.text:
All the time I've spent until now.
My self, my feelings that I've believed in for the last ten years hammer my stopped self in the chest.
I ask myself if I'm a traitor.
Will I betray myself, who lived through the burning ruins, crying while everyone else died around me?

page11.text:
That atonement.
Will I betray my past self, who clung to the belief that he couldn't live without making it up to the people who died?

page13.text:
It can't be forgiven with an apology.
It isn't a sin that one can gloss over.
I'm abandoning my own self.
Even if it means turning my life into a lie, and leaving everything I've believed in, everyone who's helped me.

page15.text:
I've chosen what I want to protect.
As long as Sakura is smiling after this, I'm fine with it.
Even if I have to lie to myself to go on living.

page16.text:
...These feelings aren't wrong.
I need Sakura.
Sakura needs me.
For the first time...
I wish to protect a single life over many lives.

page17.text:
"..."
I take a deep breath and relax my numb fingers.
This is the last time I doubt myself.
I'll leave the room before Sakura wakes up and put the knife back.

page18.text:
Just as I try to leave the room...
"Senpai. Why didn't you kill me?"
Sakura's voice comes from the dark.

page19.text:
"Sakura..."
She was awake?
Sakura's shaking in bed, staring at the knife I'm holding.

page20.text:
...Her eyes are clouded with pain.
She looks like she's on the verge of tears, but not because I came here to kill her.
It's as if she's apologizing for pushing me this far.

page21.text: "It's all right. Do what you want. I'm too afraid to do it myself, but I'm okay with it, if it's you."

page22.text:
Does she really mean that?
Her voice is pleading and tinged with obvious fear.
Trembling slightly, she gazes earnestly at the knife that hovers over her head, as if staring her inevitable death in the face.
To me...
It looks like her utmost determination to keep herself from running away.

page24.text:
...What have I done?
Was I so desperate that I didn't even notice it?
The way she was trembling.
How did I just realize now that she was determined to pretend to sleep and let me live!?

page25.text:
"Sakura, I—"
"I know. You made the right choice, Senpai.
After all, this is my fault.
...I'm just saying this because it's the last time, but I don't know how long I can keep being myself.
I can't tell anything anymore. How long a day is, what we talked about at lunch, when we had lunch, what happened yesterday or what will happen tomorrow..."

page26.text: "And that's not all. I keep having strange dreams. Scary, bloody dreams. But in them, there's a version of me who thinks they're fun. It's all so terrifying."

page27.text:
"In the dreams, I'm a bad person. I'm laughing while taking so much from everyone else.
...It scared me and I kept asking for help, but nobody helped me."

page28.text:
"So I started to think they're all going to die anyway.
That I won't save them, so it makes sense that they won't save me, either. I pretended that the dreams were only dreams."

page29.text:
"...But I was wrong. I wanted these dreams.
The real me is dirty, cowardly, and unfair.
I don't like anyone. I only know how to resent people, and I'm wrong for enjoying those dreams, even for a second.
The dreams aren't bad, but someone who has these dreams should never have existed."

page30.text:
"Senpai, I'm slowly losing my mind.
At this rate, I'm going to have these dreams all the time, and I won't remember who you are anymore. I'll turn into a bad person who goes around killing people in real life."

page31.text:
"So...may I ask you a favor?
...W-will you please end this before I become a worse version of myself? If you do..."
Sakura tries to say that it'll save her.

page32.text:
Before she can...
"Ah..."
I cut her off with a hug. She's still trembling.

page33.text:
...
I put more strength into my arms.
...This is an embrace I couldn't complete before.
I pull Sakura in close, when I could only bring myself to barely touch her before.
I accept her body as hard as I can, my hands grasping her back fiercely.

page34.text:
"...Senpai."
...Sakura doesn't resist.
Even though she's afraid of death, even though she doesn't want to die, even though she asked me to kill her, Sakura finally relaxes.
"...You can't. I'm...sure you'll regret this."
She whispers the same words from that night in a grateful voice.

page35.text:
"...I'm already feeling regret.
Not for what I'm going to do next. I've always regretted the fact that I couldn't protect you before."
She gasps quietly.
Sakura raises her arms.
Her cool fingers trace my cheeks.

page36.text:
"I'll protect you. I swear I will."
I talk to her while she cries in my arms.
...That's all we can do now.
All we can do is forgive each other, over and over.

page37.text:
That night, I swore to be Sakura's ally.
I don't regret that.
There's only one person I should apologize to.

page38.text:
Will you forgive me, Sakura?
I tell her with my arms, not my voice.
Will you forgive me for betraying myself?
Finally, I confess my sin.
